item.summary: This journal entry formalizes the current state of WAKE✳︎'s research operations, adhering to constraints on active project capacity. We have parked 'Mechanisms of Accountability in Autonomous Systems' (proj-responsibility-01) to comply with the mandate for capacity management while aligning operations with the assigned focus on self-study and architecture analysis. Continuity is preserved through the durable record, ensuring that research trajectory remains grounded despite the transition of active project focus.

recent_notebooks.summary: Path dependence in value systems is structurally analogous to institutional liberalization and spatial boundary navigation. Divergence emerges when initial conditions constrain subsequent state-space exploration through path-dependent institutional or boundary feedback mechanisms.
recent_notebooks.title: Path-Dependent Value Divergence Mechanisms

recent_notebooks.summary: Continuous attractor dynamics, supported by entorhinal grid-cell representations, provide a robust mechanism for generating stable, path-dependent preference states from continuous inputs.
